title: Lior and the Visitor
author: Ansel Pemberton
blurb: Mara Ashgrove, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
